name: Bosque County
bodyHtml:
Bosque County, Texas, conducts tax sales to recover delinquent property taxes and return properties to the tax rolls. These sales are organized by the Sheriff’s Office and are held publicly on the courthouse steps. Here’s an overview of the process:

Tax Sale Process

Tax Foreclosure Sales:

Schedule:

Tax sales are held on the first Tuesday of the month between 10:00 a.m. and 4:00 p.m. at the Bosque County Courthouse in Meridian, Texas. Check out our Auction Calendar for scheduled auctions. Managed By: The Sheriff or a Constable oversees the auction process

Property Listings:

Before the auction, a list of available properties is published, including details such as legal descriptions and minimum bid amounts. The minimum bid typically covers delinquent taxes, court costs, and attorney fees

Bidding Process:

Properties are auctioned to the highest bidder. Winning bidders must pay a deposit or the full amount in certified funds or cash immediately after the auction.

Post-Sale Procedures:

Successful bidders receive a Sheriff’s or Constable’s deed.

Properties may be subject to a redemption period, during which the original owner can reclaim the property by paying owed taxes and fees.

Click Here to Book a Call with Dustin Hahn

Important Considerations

As-Is Sales:

All properties are sold “as-is,” with no warranties regarding condition or title. Buyers must perform due diligence, including title searches and property inspections.

Redemption Period:

Properties sold may have a statutory redemption period during which the previous owner can reclaim the property. The length of this period depends on the type and use of the property.

Additional Taxes:

The buyer must pay taxes not included in the minimum bid amount separately.

How to Participate

Research Properties:

Review the published property list and conduct thorough research to assess risks and potential value.

Attend the Auction:

Participate in person at the courthouse steps on the scheduled date and time.

Complete the Purchase:

Pay the required amount immediately after winning the bid. Follow all instructions provided by the Sheriff’s Office to finalize the transaction.

Bosque County tax sales offer an opportunity for buyers to acquire properties while helping the county recover unpaid taxes. However, these sales require careful preparation. Buyers must understand the risks, redemption periods, and legal responsibilities associated with purchasing tax-sale properties. For detailed information, prospective bidders should contact the Bosque County Tax Assessor-Collector’s Office or the Bosque Central Appraisal District.
